map.按离职人数、替换成本与胜任周期测算离职总成本与留人收益: Estimate the total cost of turnover and the benefit of retention from headcount leaving, replacement cost and time to competence
map.离职的真实代价远大于招聘费用：新人到岗后需要胜任周期才能产出，这段时间按人均产出: The real cost of turnover far exceeds the hiring expense: a new hire needs a period of time to become competent before producing, and that period counts as a capacity ramp loss at half of average output per person, which often exceeds the replacement cost itself. The tool adds the two parts to get the total turnover cost and divides it per person to judge a sensible ceiling on retention spending; it also gives the amount saved by cutting turnover by 30% so you can weigh the return on retention measures. Turnover rate uses the period basis (people leaving divided by headcount). All calculations run locally in the browser and no data is uploaded.
map.离职率 = 离职人数 ÷ 在职人数 × 100%；替换成本 = 离职人数 × 单: Turnover rate = people leaving ÷ headcount × 100%; replacement cost = people leaving × cost per replacement; capacity ramp loss = people leaving × time to competence × average monthly output × 50%; total turnover cost = replacement cost + capacity ramp loss

map.在职 200 人、期间离职 18 人、单人替换成本 24000 元、胜任周期 2: With 200 in post, 18 leaving, a replacement cost of 24000 CNY each, a 2-month time to competence and average monthly output of 30000 CNY: turnover rate = 18/200 = 9.00%; replacement cost 432000 CNY; capacity ramp loss = 18×2×30000×0.5 = 540000 CNY; total turnover cost 972000 CNY, or 54000 CNY per person; cutting turnover by 30% would save 291600 CNY.
map.为什么产能损失按 50% 折算？: Why is capacity loss counted at 50%?
map.新人在胜任期内产出逐步爬坡，粗略按满产的一半估算；若岗位学习曲线较长，可自行调高: A new hire's output ramps up during the time to competence, so it is roughly estimated at half of full output; if the role has a long learning curve, raise the time to competence yourself.
map.离职率多少需要预警？: At what turnover rate should you worry?
map.行业差异大，一般 8% 以下属较低、8%–15% 中等、15% 以上偏高；核心技: It varies a lot by industry: under 8% is generally low, 8%-15% moderate and above 15% high. Core technical and managerial roles should be tracked separately.
